candidates.name: Necrotizing fasciitis
support_spans: Large and deep, irregularly shaped, cutaneous ulcer on the dorsum of right forearm with necrotic tissue and muscle exposure at the base
candidates.why: Presence of necrotic tissue and muscle exposure at the base of the ulcer

candidates.name: Scleroderma
support_spans: Woody induration of skin on both forearms and abdominal region
candidates.why: Presence of woody induration of skin

candidates.name: Contracture deformity
support_spans: Bilateral contracture of deltoid, triceps, and biceps muscles
candidates.why: Presence of bilateral contracture of muscles

candidates.name: Panniculitis
support_spans: Shows lobular panniculitis, subcutaneous fat lobules with necrotic adipocytes and dense inflammatory infiltrates composed mainly of foamy histiocytes
candidates.why: Presence of lobular panniculitis on histopathology

candidates.name: Ehlers-Danlos syndrome
support_spans: Large and deep, irregularly shaped, cutaneous ulcer on the dorsum of right forearm with necrotic tissue and muscle exposure at the base
candidates.why: Presence of skin fragility and poor wound healing

candidates.name: Intramuscular injection-induced contracture
support_spans: Patient admitted to self-administering subcutaneous injections of meperidine, 100 mg 4 times per day, for the past 3 years, at different sites, including the deltoid areas and abdomen
candidates.why: Repeated intramuscular injections can cause contracture and fibrosis

candidates.name: Fibrosis
support_spans: Severe fibrosis in deep dermis and subcutaneous septa

candidates.name: Inflammatory myopathy
support_spans: Elevated serum creatinine kinase (192 U/L; reference range, 0-174 U/L)
candidates.why: Elevated creatinine kinase levels suggest muscle inflammation

candidates.name: Lipodermatosclerosis
support_spans: Woody induration of skin on both forearms and abdominal region
candidates.why: Presence of woody induration of skin

candidates.name: Chronic pain syndrome
support_spans: 7-year history of severe, mechanical, low back pain
